definitions.explanation: A stone set up with words carved on it, to commemorate a person or event or to mark a place. On its own a written word; it is more often met in compounds such as {記念碑|きねんひ} and {石碑|せきひ}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{詩人|しじん}→詩人：03171_shijin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{碑|ひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a monument to a poet in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{津波|つなみ}→津波：05064_tsunami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教訓|きょうくん}→教訓：12721_kyoukun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧{碑|ひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見下|みお}ろす→見下ろす：04569_miorosu⟧⟦{丘|おか}→丘：02183_oka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}っている→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A monument passing on the lessons of the tsunami stands on a hill overlooking the sea.

notes:
Also read いしぶみ in poetic writing. With the same sound as ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧, ⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧ and other common words, the single word is rare in speech; {記念碑|きねんひ} or ⟦{石碑|せきひ}→石碑：13725_sekihi⟧ is clearer.

COMPOUNDS:
- {記念碑|きねんひ}: memorial, monument
- ⟦{石碑|せきひ}→石碑：13725_sekihi⟧: stone monument
- ⟦{慰霊碑|いれいひ}→慰霊碑：25515_ireihi⟧: memorial to the dead
- {句碑|くひ} / {歌碑|かひ}: a stone carved with a haiku / a tanka
- {碑文|ひぶん}: the inscription on a monument
